raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Allow MoE backends to describe physical routing rows through an optional capture layout instead of replacing the shared capturer. Relates to #61539 and preserves the default restoration introduced by #61388.

## Claims

- Optional process-group shard sizes and ordered source spans restore uneven TP shards and skip interior padding.
- Layout metadata passes through the router before EPLB mapping, so capture retains logical expert IDs.
- Calls without a layout retain the default restoration and previous callback/selection signatures. Empty capture ranges still participate in the supplied collective.

## Validation

Tested implementation: `bfed1cb65d2ae8c37b9ada7b45191bbb01224679`, based on main `852989f580820849113d67d13fd8053e279d0444`.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Complete existing capture regression module, including added cases | **64 passed in 10.36s** (macOS arm64, torch 2.14.0) |
| Full pre-commit on all four changed files | **PASS**, including mypy and CI test tethering |
| Ascend A3 / HCCL component integration, DP=1/2 and TP=2 | **216 per-rank checks; 2,760 captured expert IDs; zero differences** |
| Full-model Ascend A3 serving/API, DP=1/2 and TP=1/2/4 | **17 configurations, 144 requests; 16,048,896 API IDs and 31,912,320 worker-buffer IDs; zero differences** |

[Reproducer, source fingerprints and complete passing logs](https://github.com/Liamup777/vllm/tree/65293f23a7f682d19a4d3c18b1081216ef6aab3d/validation/capture-layout-20261019).

The real-device harness calls the actual downstream prepare methods, a BaseRouter subclass using NPU top-k, and this upstream capturer. It covers ALLGATHER prepare, uneven ALLTOALL prepare, ALLTOALL SP inputs, MC2 prepare with/without SP, and empty capture ranges. Every case runs in eager and actual ACL graph replay, with three changed routing inputs after warmup. An independent CPU top-k over the original local input provides expected rows; it does not use the emitted layout. An observable post-routing mapping also checks capture-before-EPLB ordering.

The DP=2 MC2+SP case uses token counts (5,13), physical shards (7,7), and valid DP0 offsets (0,1,2,7,8), including graph replay. Each worker's loaded capturer SHA256 was checked against the proposed source. NPU validation uses torch 2.10.0+cpu / torch-npu 2.10.0.post4 and the existing downstream layout adapter; exact adapter hashes are archived.

Fresh **full-model serving** validation now also passes on the same submitted head: Qwen3-30B-A3B BF16/W8A8, 17 configurations and 144 HTTP requests. A test-only device trace records raw logical router IDs and independently transported DP/row labels before production capture. The offline oracle does not read the layout metadata: it reconstructs token ownership from those labels, then compares every TP worker buffer and every API element by request/token/layer/top-k. All saved traces were rechecked after serving, with **zero differences across 16,048,896 API IDs and 31,912,320 worker-buffer IDs**. This uses the same 17-configuration matrix as the earlier prototype, with fresh runs against the submitted implementation.

The full-model matrix exercises actual ALLGATHER/ALLTOALL/MC2/FUSED_MC2 selection, DP=1/2, TP=1/2/4, SP on/off, uneven TP shards and interior padding. Four graph configurations have confirmed actual ACL graph replay; device tracing executes inside replay and resets validity before each forward to avoid stale warmup data. LoRA coverage is the enable flag only, without a loaded adapter. Some graph **log-only** coverage reports remain INCONCLUSIVE because replay does not re-emit Python callbacks; raw device/API comparison passes for every configuration, and checked selector/layout assertions have no failures.

[Full-model per-case results, oracle, source fingerprints and compatibility diffs](https://github.com/Liamup777/vllm/tree/1eb3183cacfefb7e5ebfd8bf547e5a76e56962fd/validation/capture-layout-e2e-20261019). Original raw arrays and server/startup logs are retained in the recorded validation environment; a SHA256-verified full archive was also copied locally.

**Runtime compatibility boundary:** existing Ascend code cannot directly serve against this main snapshot. Full-model tests used isolated copies with separate downstream compatibility fixes for moved imports, configuration/planner/block-table and runner signatures; TP-aligned graph-size filtering and the prior internal-NPU-format initialization were restored for four retry configurations. Those changes and per-case hashes are archived separately. The four submitted upstream files were not changed for testing, and the capturer SHA256 matches the PR in every run. These results establish capture correctness in that adapted runtime, not stock Ascend compatibility with this upstream snapshot. Original repositories were left unchanged and test services stopped.

Reproduce the CPU suite:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/model_executor tests/model_executor/test_routed_experts_capture.py -q
```

Scope: component and full-model results are reported separately. No PP/PCP, multi-node, loaded-LoRA, other model/accelerator or performance claim. ALLGATHER+MoE-SP was not naturally selected on this hardware and is not claimed as full-model coverage. NPU checks run outside upstream CI; the CPU tests extend an existing CI-tethered module.

## Details

For physical shards `(7,7)`, `source_ranges=((0,3),(7,2))` records five rows in token order and skips padding between shards. Backends construct this metadata where physical ownership is known; upstream performs gather/select/write. No model, scheduler or model-runner changes are included.

The existing default restoration helper is unchanged. This does not duplicate #61388: it adds an explicit contract for backend row layouts that cannot be inferred from shape alone. No open implementation PR for #61539 or capture-layout support was found during duplicate checks.

The prototype takes a raw `torch.distributed.ProcessGroup`; a vLLM communication abstraction is an alternative for review. The group's backend must support the supplied shard shapes. All ranks must supply compatible collective plans, and sizes/ranges must stay stable across graph replay. No Python communication hook or new host read of accelerator tensor values is introduced.

AI assistance was used for the implementation, tests, device-validation harness and this description.

     unsupported = VllmConfig._get_v2_model_runner_unsupported_features(config)
 
     assert "routed experts capture" not in unsupported
+
+
+def test_explicit_capture_layout_selects_padded_dp_block():
+    capturer = _capturer_with_buffer(dp_rank=1)
+    ids = torch.arange(14, dtype=torch.int32).view(-1, 1).repeat(1, 2)
+    layout = RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout(((7, 7),))
+
+    capturer.capture(layer_id=0, topk_ids=ids, layout=layout)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(capturer.device_buffer[:7, 0], ids[7:14])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("shard_sizes", "ranges", "expected_rows"),
+    [
+        ((3, 2), ((0, 5),), [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]),
+        ((7, 7), ((0, 3), (7, 2)), [0, 1, 2, 7, 8]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_explicit_capture_layout_gathers_and_skips_internal_padding(
+    shard_sizes, ranges, expected_rows
+):
+    capturer = _capturer_with_buffer()
+    group = object()
+    local = torch.arange(shard_sizes[1], dtype=torch.int32).repeat(2, 1).T
+    layout = RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout(ranges, group, shard_sizes)
+
+    def gather(outputs, input_, group):
+        assert input_.shape[0] == shard_sizes[1]
+        assert input_.is_contiguous()
+        for rank, output in enumerate(outputs):
+            output.copy_(
+                torch.arange(sum(shard_sizes[:rank]), sum(shard_sizes[: rank + 1]))
+                .to(torch.int32)
+                .view(-1, 1)
+                .repeat(1, 2)
+            )
+
+    with (
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.get_world_size", return_value=2),
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.get_rank", return_value=1),
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.all_gather", side_effect=gather),
+    ):
+        capturer.capture(layer_id=0, topk_ids=local, layout=layout)
+
+    expected = torch.tensor(expected_rows, dtype=torch.int32).view(-1, 1).repeat(1, 2)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(capturer.device_buffer[:5, 0], expected)
+
+
+def test_explicit_capture_layout_rejects_invalid_source_rows():
+    capturer = _capturer_with_buffer()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="source range"):
+        capturer.capture(
+            0,
+            torch.ones((2, 2), dtype=torch.int32),
+            layout=RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout(((1, 2),)),
+        )
+
+
+def test_router_forwards_layout_before_eplb_mapping():
+    router = _make_router()
+    recorded = []
+    layout = RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout(((0, 2),))
+    router.set_capture_fn(lambda ids, *, layout: recorded.append((ids.clone(), layout)))
+
+    _, routed_ids = router.select_experts(
+        torch.ones((2, 4)), torch.ones((2, 4)), capture_layout=layout
+    )
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(recorded[0][0], routed_ids - 10)
+    assert recorded[0][1] is layout
+
+
+def test_capture_layout_keeps_empty_rank_in_collective():
+    capturer = _capturer_with_buffer()
+    layout = RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout((), object(), (2, 0))
+    with (
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.get_world_size", return_value=2),
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.get_rank", return_value=1),
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.all_gather") as gather,
+    ):
+        capturer.capture(0, torch.empty((0, 2), dtype=torch.int32), layout=layout)
+    gather.assert_called_once()
+    assert (capturer.device_buffer == -1).all()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("sizes", "group", "message"),
+    [
+        ((2,), object(), "group size"),
+        ((2, -1), object(), "non-negative"),
+        ((2, 3), object(), "local rows"),
+        ((2, 2), None, "require a gather group"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_capture_rejects_invalid_collective_layout_before_gather(sizes, group, message):
+    capturer = _capturer_with_buffer()
+    with (
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.get_world_size", return_value=2),
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.get_rank", return_value=1),
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.all_gather") as gather,
+        pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message),
+    ):
+        capturer.capture(
+            0,
+            torch.ones((2, 2), dtype=torch.int32),
+            layout=RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout(((0, 2),), group, sizes),
+        )
+    gather.assert_not_called()
+    assert (capturer.device_buffer == -1).all()
+
+
+def test_capture_layout_rejects_invalid_layer_before_collective():

+    with (
+        patch(f"{_REC_MODULE}.dist.all_gather") as gather,
+        pytest.raises(IndexError, match="layer"),

+        capturer.capture(
+            -1,
+            torch.ones((2, 2), dtype=torch.int32),
+            layout=RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout(((0, 4),), object(), (2, 2)),
+        )
+    gather.assert_not_called()

+
+def test_capture_layout_does_not_write_past_buffer_capacity():
+    capturer = _capturer_with_buffer(max_tokens=2)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="capacity"):
+        capturer.capture(
+            0,
+            torch.ones((3, 2), dtype=torch.int32),
+            layout=RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout(((0, 3),)),
+        )
+    assert (capturer.device_buffer == -1).all()

+def test_default_router_keeps_legacy_selection_signature(monkeypatch):
+    router = _make_router()
+    expected = (torch.ones((2, 2)), torch.ones((2, 2), dtype=torch.int32))
+
+    def select(
+        hidden_states, router_logits, topk_indices_dtype=None, *, input_ids=None
+    ):
+        return expected
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(router, "_select_experts", select)
+    result = router.select_experts(torch.ones((2, 4)), torch.ones((2, 4)))
+    assert result[0] is expected[0] and result[1] is expected[1]

 import logging
 from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
 from functools import partial
 from typing import Protocol, runtime_checkable
 
 import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
 
 from vllm.config import VllmConfig
 from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_tp_group
@@ -27,6 +29,26 @@ class RoutedExpertsCaptureSource(Protocol):
     capture_fn: Callable[[torch.Tensor], None] | None
 
 
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout:
+    """Physical routing rows and their order in the local capture buffer.
+
+    ``source_ranges`` are (start, length) spans in the concatenated input,
+    after an optional gather. They are copied in order; padding can be skipped
+    between spans. All sizes and spans must be stable across a graph replay.
+
+    For example, two physical shards of seven rows can contain three and two
+    valid local rows. ``shard_sizes=(7, 7)`` and
+    ``source_ranges=((0, 3), (7, 2))`` record those five rows in token order.
+    Shard sizes follow process-group rank order. The supplied group's backend
+    must support all_gather with the given shard sizes, including empty shards.
+    """
+
+    source_ranges: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]
+    gather_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None = None
+    shard_sizes: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+
+
 def _get_routed_experts_shape(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
     model_config = vllm_config.model_config
     num_layers = model_config.get_total_num_hidden_layers()
@@ -84,16 +106,75 @@ def __init__(
         self.dp_rank = vllm_config.parallel_config.data_parallel_rank
         self.tp_size = vllm_config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
 
-    def capture(self, layer_id: int, topk_ids: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    def capture(
+        self,
+        layer_id: int,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        layout: RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Record logical expert IDs, optionally restoring explicit row spans.
+
+        The backend must provide the same collective plan on every group rank.
+        Sizes and spans must remain stable across graph replay. When no layout
+        is supplied, preserve the default row-restoration behavior.
+        """
         if not 0 <= layer_id < self.device_buffer.shape[1]:
             raise IndexError(
                 f"routed-experts layer {layer_id} exceeds capture buffer "
                 f"layer count {self.device_buffer.shape[1]}"
             )
 
-        local_topk_ids = self._restore_local_topk_ids(topk_ids, get_forward_context())
+        if layout is None:
+            local_topk_ids = self._restore_local_topk_ids(
+                topk_ids, get_forward_context()
+            )
+        else:
+            local_topk_ids = self._capture_with_layout(topk_ids, layout)
+            if len(local_topk_ids) > len(self.device_buffer):
+                raise ValueError("routed-experts rows exceed capture buffer capacity")
         self.device_buffer[: len(local_topk_ids), layer_id] = local_topk_ids
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _capture_with_layout(
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor, layout: RoutedExpertsCaptureLayout
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if layout.gather_group is not None:
+            world_size = dist.get_world_size(layout.gather_group)
+            if len(layout.shard_sizes) != world_size:
+                raise ValueError("capture shard_sizes must match gather group size")
+            if any(size < 0 for size in layout.shard_sizes):
+                raise ValueError("capture shard_sizes must be non-negative")
+            rank = dist.get_rank(layout.gather_group)
+            if topk_ids.shape[0] != layout.shard_sizes[rank]:
+                raise ValueError("capture local rows do not match shard_sizes")
+            gathered = torch.empty(
+                (sum(layout.shard_sizes), *topk_ids.shape[1:]),
+                dtype=topk_ids.dtype,
+                device=topk_ids.device,
+            )
+            shards = list(torch.split(gathered, layout.shard_sizes, dim=0))
+            dist.all_gather(shards, topk_ids.contiguous(), group=layout.gather_group)
+            topk_ids = gathered
+        elif layout.shard_sizes:
+            raise ValueError("capture shard_sizes require a gather group")
+
+        ranges = layout.source_ranges
+        if not ranges:
+            return topk_ids[:0]
+        if any(
+            start < 0 or length < 0 or start + length > len(topk_ids)
+            for start, length in ranges
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("capture source range exceeds available rows")
+        if len(ranges) == 1:
+            start, length = ranges[0]
+            return topk_ids.narrow(0, start, length)
+        return torch.cat(
+            [topk_ids.narrow(0, start, length) for start, length in ranges],
+            dim=0,
+        )
+
     def _restore_local_topk_ids(
